previs.note: The motion pass follows this grey render: camera path, lens, blocking and light. Looks come from the shot prompt and Soul Cast.
previs.empty: No shots to block. Add rows to the slate first.
previs.hint_overhead: Overhead plan: amber is this shot, cyan the others; each triangle is a camera at this frame. Drag a round K marker to place one of this shot's camera keys. Drag elsewhere to pan, scroll to zoom.
previs.hint_free: Orbit to frame, then press Set start or Set end under Framing. That rewrites the first or last camera key (K1 or the last K) and drops any key in between.
previs.keys: ↑ ↓ switch shots · Space plays the shot
previs.step1: Pick a shot. It starts from the slate: camera move, lens and action.
previs.step2: Block it below. Lens looks through the shot camera; Overhead (or Split) shows every camera in the set, and there you drag the K markers to place this shot's camera keys. Time them on the Camera row of the Beats track.
previs.step3: Render previs: a grey clip saved to the shot's Previs cell, with its actor matte in Actor Matte.
previs.step4: Run motion pass: the AI shoots the shot along this camera and blocking, then waits for your review.
previs.renderFirst: Render the previs first; the motion pass follows the saved clip.
previs.step5: Or run layout render: FLUX 3 Klein paints frame 0 for your review, then the Layout-To-Render IC-LoRA shoots the shot on this set and camera.
previs.layoutHint: Layout Key (FLUX 3 Klein on previs frame 0, reviewed) then Layout Render (LTX-2.5 Layout-To-Render IC-LoRA keeps the set and camera; the actor matte frees the actor and LTX-2.3 Union-Control takes the acting from the pose skeleton). About 3 minutes on an RTX 4090.
previs.renderMatte: Render the previs again to save the actor matte and pose skeleton; the layout render needs both.
previs.hint_split: Left: overhead plan (drag a K marker to place a camera key, drag elsewhere to pan, scroll to zoom). Right: the shot's lens.
previs.layersFromSet: Far card: @{{id}} from this shot. Camera moves slide the cards for parallax.
previs.layersPlaceholder: Grey depth cards (far, mid, near). Tag the shot with an @SET that has an image to use it as the far card.
previs.pipHint: Show the shot lens in the corner while you block in this view.
previs.hint_return: Looking through the shot lens. Esc returns to {{view}}.
previs.autoFixOn: Auto-Fix is on: feet held out of the floor and locked while planted, hands kept out of the console.
previs.keyframePackHint: First and last frame as clean 1280×704 PNGs, plus a JSON with the camera at both ends and the plan.
previs.demoBeats: Walk in → settle → look at partner → touch
previs.demoDescription: A complete rehearsal with a partner and a contact object. Scrub the timeline to inspect the feet, gaze and hand placement.
previs.demoStep2: 4–5 s: plant both feet and settle.
previs.demoLocal: This demonstration uses the studio's character, motion and render pipeline. Previewing or downloading it does not change your shot.
previs.ghostLegend: {{shot}} has a proposed camera, dashed on the plan.
previs.dragHint: Drag the amber square to place the actor and the round K markers to frame the camera path. Shift = no snap, arrows = 10 cm, Esc = put it back.
previs.beatsHint: Camera row: each K is a camera key. Drag it to change when the camera reaches it; set where the camera sits at that key in Overhead or Split. Acting row: drag a block to move it, its right edge to change how long it runs.
previs.beatsBuiltin: This shot uses the built-in action “{{action}}”, whose timing is fixed. Walk in and shots with motion skills have beats you can drag.
previs.moveRangeReset: Spread the move over the whole shot
previs.moveEasingReset: Back to smooth in and out
previs.moveNote: The first and last camera keys (K1 and the last K) set when the move starts and stops; the curve shapes the travel between them.
